mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, increasing present value and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as central bank accommodation supports risk-taking.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC over 2-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) by >1.0% signal broad consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of interaction periods, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) during manufacturing slowdowns signals weakening output capacity, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC over 5-year windows drops below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation above 2.5% signals central bank tightening pressure, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 45% of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% periods, or Rank IC over 3-year windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll growth below 50,000 (PAYEMS) indicates labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending momentum and corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of PAYEMS < 50k instances, or Rank IC over 2-year windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent deceleration in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) by >0.5% signals economic contraction, lowering earnings expectations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of interaction periods, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%), rising inflation (CPIAUCSL) accelerates rate hike expectations, increasing bond yields and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% periods, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02.
